note: Article inversion. 519 occurrences (5.2%) in the reference corpus. The article moves to the end of the FIRST ' - ' segment, matching No-Intro: 'Addams Family, The - Pugsley's Scavenger Hunt'.
invertNote: ONLY 'The' rewrites a title. Every other article is ambiguous with real leading title words and rewriting them corrupts real files: 'Die Hard' (German article vs English verb), 'Las Vegas Cool Hand' (Spanish article vs proper noun), 'An M. Night Shyamalan Film - The Last Airbender' (real article No-Intro left un-inverted). 'The ' leads 0 of 9,363 canonical names, so inverting it is provably a no-op on clean data. The rest are used for grouping only.
